text:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — I'm putting up an A/B on the suppression preview + compact threshold panel in the console. Need a quick design + a11y pass before Monday. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (see frames: suppression/preview-v3).

Elena Park: On first glance the muted-pill label contrast looks low when the background is dark. Also keyboard focus disappears if you tab into the channel list on the preview.

Devon Patel: +1 on contrast. We should aim for at least AA (4.5:1) on the pill text. Regarding focus — currently focus is only on the channel row, not the pill, so keyboard users can miss it.

Kai Nguyen: Copy nit: we use both "Quiet window" and "Do not disturb" across flows. Can we standardize? "Quiet window" is less common for external users.

Maria Chen: We intentionally used "Quiet window" to match product language, but happy to standardize. @Devon any preference?

Devon Patel: I prefer "Do not disturb" for clarity, but if PMs want "Quiet window" we should make it explicit in helper text. Also — the preview ordering of channels doesn't mirror runtime priority; the preview shows channels alphabetically which is misleading.

Samir Rao: I can mock higher-contrast tokens and a stronger focus treatment. Quick CSS example for focused pill: 

```css
.pill:focus {
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-500);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.pill--muted {
  color: var(--text-muted-800); /* update token to meet 4.5:1 */
}
```

Elena Park: Nice. On mobile/smaller widths the compact threshold slider wraps awkwardly — suggest moving the explanatory help text into a tooltip that shows on hover/focus instead of inline.

Kai Nguyen: a11y point — when a user toggles suppression preview, screenreaders should announce the changed state. Add aria-live="polite" to the preview container and update the label copy to be explicit (e.g., "Suppression preview: showing notifications for selected channels").

Devon Patel: I'll own the a11y PR. Plan: 1) enforce contrast tokens, 2) keyboard nav for pill/channel list, 3) aria-live announcement, 4) test for preview ordering matching runtime policy.

Maria Chen: Thanks. Two small UI copy decisions: a) change the CTA from "Apply" to "Save preview"? b) helper copy under quiet window should read: "Silence notifications for selected channels during the specified window." Thoughts?

Kai Nguyen: I like "Save preview" — clearer intent. For helper copy maybe shorten: "Silence notifications in selected channels during this window." Keeps it scannable.

Samir Rao: I'll push updated tokens + the focus sample to the shared branch by EOD. Also will prototype a mock that shows runtime-ordered notifications (priority -> fallback).

Alerting Bot: Deploy scheduled: staging build 2026-03-22T16:00Z includes suppression-preview updates (branch: feat/suppression-preview-a11y).

Maria Chen: Great. @Devon can you take the a11y PR review? We'll reconvene in design review Wed 10am to sign off on copy and focus states. Cheers. :thumbsup:
